summary: Orchestra BioMed Holdings filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement on 2026-11-05 for a primary underwritten offering of common stock under its May 2024 shelf (File 333-279430); pricing, share count and proceeds are left blank pending completion. The last reported Nasdaq price was $6.00 on 2026-11-04; Piper Sandler, TD Cowen and BTIG are underwriters, with a 30-day option for additional shares. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, dilution and any overhang from the greenshoe.
